title: Samudra Manthanam corpus manifest, schema v1
description: Content-addressed enumeration of the canonical JSONL that makes up one immutable corpus bundle. The `bundle` object is a pure function of the inputs and carries no wall-clock field, so two builds from identical inputs are byte-identical; event-time provenance belongs in build reports, not here.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema generation. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON serialization of `bundle` alone. Identifies the bundle content; stable across rebuilds at a different build revision.

generator.description: Tool identity that produced the manifest, e.g. corpus_manifest/1.

revision.description: Source revision the build ran at (git sha, or 'unknown' outside a checkout).

bundle_version.description: Release label for this bundle. An input to the build, never derived from a clock.

corpus_root.description: Directory every `path` in this manifest is relative to, itself relative to the repository root.

sources.description: Every canonical source in the bundle, ordered by (sort_order, slug).

generated_artifacts.description: Inventory of the views this bundle is expected to generate. Actual output hashes are recorded by build reports against this manifest's content_hash, never written back here.

relativePath.description: Forward-slash relative path. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected so a manifest is host-independent.

slug.description: Stable URL/identity slug. Unique across the bundle.

filename.description: Legacy desktop corpus filename this source is published under.

provenance.description: Where the canonical text came from. Required: a bundle may not contain a source of unrecorded origin.

rights.description: Known rights facts, recorded rather than adjudicated. Absent means not yet recorded, never means unrestricted.

canonical.description: The JSONL that is actually ingested and published for this source.

source_file.description: Optional upstream HTML/text the canonical JSONL was derived from. A compatibility view, never the publication input.
